why: Two corrections a third independent review found, neither visible to any gate. CLM-testing-136 note gave dashcheck2.py the subject of pty-control-arm.py; both carry three-state exits but about different things. The stderr status line claim was retagged from ENGINEERING/LOCAL_ENV to OFFICIAL/SRC_STATUSLINE because the official page documents it, so claiming direct observation overstated the evidence. Ids are BASELINE ids.

changes.to: Added 2026-08-22 from two ccxe checks with three-state exits, each about a different subject: tools/pty-control-arm.py exits 0 if the status line ran, 1 if it did not, and 2 if the arm could not run; tools/dashcheck2.py exits 0 on no banned characters, 1 on finding some, and 2 on ABORT when its anchors do not resolve or its positive control fails to fire. Corrected after a review found the first version had given dashcheck2 the other file subject.
